Generate an interactive Germany map of Odoo contacts (click markers to open the record in Odoo).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Generate an interactive Germany map of Odoo contacts as HTML.
- Uses Leaflet for mapping and links each marker to the corresponding Odoo record.
- Reads contact data from Odoo (res.partner), using stored coordinates or geocoding via Nominatim as needed.
- Popups show name, address, email, phone, and “Open in Odoo” link.
- Filters available (e.g. by city); adjustable via script arguments.
- Requires Odoo access details via environment variables for secure authentication.
